catches.title: Photogrammetric 3D Model-Based Animal Behavior Classification
catches.ctx: Video-based behavior estimation is often implemented end-to-end from image sequences. We advocate a two-stage alternative: reconstruct 3D body and object geometry before classifying behavior.
